map.：4 部电梯 × 35.3 kWh × 365 天 ≈ 51538 kWh，按: : 4 elevators × 35.3 kWh × 365 days ≈ 51538 kWh, at 0.6 yuan/kWh -> annual cost ≈ 30,900 yuan, can be the base for shared elevator fee.
map.哪些因素最影响电梯电耗？: Which factors most affect elevator energy use?
map.运行趟数、层站数、载荷率与待机功耗；错峰加变频通常可降 15%–30%。: Runs, stops, load rate and standby power; peak shifting plus VFD usually cuts 15%-30%.
map.估算值和实表差很多怎么办？: What if the estimate differs a lot from the real meter?
map.以电表为准，估算用于预算与公示基线；差异大说明趟数或载荷假设偏离实际，应修正参数: Use the meter as standard; estimation is for budget and disclosure baseline; a large difference means trip count or load assumptions deviate from reality, should correct parameters.
